evals.prompt: Provide a principal-architect service selection trade-off matrix comparing: (1) **Amazon Athena** vs **Amazon Redshift Serverless / RA3** vs **Amazon OpenSearch Service** for query serving, and (2) **AWS Glue Spark ETL** vs **Amazon EMR Serverless** vs **Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink** for data processing, including when to use Zero-ETL integrations vs explicit ETL pipelines.
evals.expected_output: Structured service comparison matrix across latency, concurrency, cost model, and workload fit (`references/glue-etl-optimization.md`), plus clear guidance on AWS Zero-ETL integrations (Aurora/RDS/DynamoDB -> Redshift or S3 Tables) vs custom Glue/EMR/Flink transformations.
expectations: Compares query engines accurately: **Amazon Athena** (serverless ad-hoc SQL over S3/Iceberg, per-TB scanned pricing) vs **Amazon Redshift Serverless / RA3** (sub-second high-concurrency BI dashboards, complex multi-way star-schema joins, materialized views) vs **Amazon OpenSearch Service** (full-text BM25, k-NN vector search, real-time log observability).
